apiCapture.description: enable API network recording for this session

networkOptions.description: network filters; ignored unless apiCapture is set

saveHarContent.description: HAR bodies: none (default, truncated) or full (unredacted)

saveStoragePath.description: storage-state file to write when the session ends

sessionGoal.description: journey intent used for generated test names

targetLanguage.description: codegen language metadata; SHAFT emits Java only

targetUrl.description: initial http, https, or file URL; blank opens about:blank

testIdAttribute.description: preferred test id attribute, such as data-testid

timeoutMillis.description: browser timeout in milliseconds; 0 means none

userDataDirectory.description: persistent profile directory; blank uses a temp profile

viewportSize.description: viewport as width,height pixels, such as 1280,720

targetBrowser.description: browser to launch on the WEB engine; blank/omitted defers to the configured targetBrowserName property (default chrome); PLAYWRIGHT/MOBILE engines resolve their own default independently
